blind.description: An ornate classical upholstered footstool or bench. It features a rectangular padded top upholstered in dark green fabric with gold decorative patterns/motifs, resting on an off-white/cream wooden frame with gold gilded accents. It has four square fluted legs connected by an X-shaped cross stretcher with a central decorative finial. All surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and continuous.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a rectangular green cushion with gold pattern motifs, edged with a thin cream and gold border at the corners where the frame and legs meet.
blind.height_vs_figure: It stands about 1.5 feet tall (reaching roughly knee height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and is approximately 1.5 to 2 feet wide.
